notes: The sentence is about a creative video platform, so Entertainment leads, but the thing being built is a filming set for roleplays and scene-by-scene stories, and Roleplay & Avatar Sim is doing real work — its scenic-backdrop option is written for exactly this, spots built as backgrounds for screenshots and roleplay scenes. I took its settlement-static shape and its Morph Roleplay preset, since a fixed pre-built city with no personal property is precisely a filming set, and added path-street for the streets a compact city set is made of plus settlement-density for the author's small, dense collection of recognisable areas. This build is the city set only, which the author picked as first and confirmed the sets stay separate selectable places rather than zones of one map, so it is single-zone P0 rather than P4 — the same logic the genre uses for a hub whose portals lead to genuinely separate places. Decided without a user: no building-interior, since neither the prompt nor the answers commit to filming indoors and adding it would push a compact camera-oriented set onto P3, so interiors are set aside for a later pass; the editor, profiles, promotion and copyright tooling are systems with no layout footprint at all.
